title: Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian, Tempe, Arizona
supports_claim: The NTSB found the 2018 Tempe crash involved an ADS test vehicle and identified operator monitoring, safety-risk assessment, oversight, and automation complacency as contributing issues.
limitations: This report analyzes one US crash and does not establish performance of any future AV system or Vietnam pilot.

title: Recall Query RQ24009: Tesla Autopilot System Driver Controls
supports_claim: NHTSA opened a recall query to evaluate remedy effectiveness after identifying post-remedy concerns and apparent driver-misuse-related crashes in its prior investigation.
limitations: An open recall query is not a final finding on every crash cause or on a different developer's system.

title: DMV Statement on Cruise LLC Suspension
supports_claim: California DMV immediately suspended Cruise deployment and driverless testing permits, citing public-safety risk and safety-information concerns.
limitations: The statement is a regulator action and does not by itself establish technical root cause or generalize to supervised pilots.

title: Cruise incident enforcement decision
supports_claim: The CPUC record describes Cruise's nationwide pause and a software remedy for post-collision response after the October 2023 incident.
limitations: The commission document concerns one company's operations and should not be treated as a universal AV safety benchmark.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: Artificial Intelligence Act
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
supports_claim: Article 6 sets high-risk classification rules for AI systems intended as safety components of products covered by listed Union harmonisation legislation.
limitations: Applicability depends on intended purpose, product-law scope, market placement, and dates; it is not a legal opinion for this pilot.

title: Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's Government published Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, relevant historical context for assessing a telemetry and video-adjacent data flow.
limitations: This decree must not be used alone to determine current controller, consent, retention, transfer, or transport obligations for the product.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports_claim: NIST AI RMF describes governance, mapping, measurement, and management activities for trustworthy AI risk management.
limitations: The voluntary framework is not a certification and does not prove that a control is effective.

title: Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam's AI Law is a current official source for assessing duties that may follow from SafeRoute's final intended purpose, AI-system classification, provider or deployer role, and deployment facts.
limitations: The final risk class, provider or deployer role, and exact duties depend on SafeRoute's final vehicle integration and intended purpose; this source is not a legal opinion.

title: Decision No. 33/2026/QD-TTg: List of High-Risk AI Systems
supports_claim: Vietnam's high-risk list includes transport AI that controls high-level autonomous vehicles without continuous human supervision or whose output directly controls vehicle behavior.
limitations: SafeRoute is described as decision support with a continuous safety driver and no vehicle-control command, so legal review must determine whether the final integrated system falls within this category and which conformity route applies.

title: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law is an official current source for reviewing SafeRoute's telemetry, camera-derived-label, safety-driver, retention, and transfer data flows.
limitations: The law's existence does not determine SafeRoute's controller roles, lawful basis, retention duration, transfer facts, or specific technical controls; those require a system-specific legal review.

title: Driver Visual Attention Before and After Take-Over Requests During Automated Driving on Public Roads
supports_claim: In a 30-participant Wizard-of-Oz public-road study, forward-road attention did not return to the manual-driving baseline until after 15 seconds following a take-over request; acknowledgement alone did not establish readiness.
limitations: The small Wizard-of-Oz study does not provide a universal takeover-time threshold and did not evaluate SafeRoute, developmental ADS testing, or its proposed operator workflow.

title: Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP detailing the Personal Data Protection Law
supports_claim: Vietnam's Decree 356/2025/ND-CP details provisions and implementation measures for the Personal Data Protection Law and took effect on 2026-01-01.
limitations: The decree title and effective date do not resolve SafeRoute's data-controller roles, data-flow facts, or specific obligations without legal review of the final system.

title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
supports_claim: The study found that a widely used health-management algorithm predicting cost rather than illness produced racial bias; changing the target would increase Black patients receiving additional help from 17.7% to 46.5%.
limitations: The study concerns a particular commercial algorithm and care-management context, not a conversational symptom-triage assistant or all populations.

title: FCC fines man behind election interference scheme $6 million for sending illegal robocalls that used deepfake generative AI technology
supports_claim: The FCC adopted a $6 million fine against Steve Kramer for illegal spoofed robocalls using an AI-generated clone of President Biden's voice to tell potential New Hampshire primary voters not to vote.
limitations: This is a specific U.S. telecommunications enforcement action; it does not estimate changed votes or establish duties for a Vietnamese text-summary prototype.
